links.outcome: Missed cancers when AI alone vs AI combined with mammography determines biopsy deferral
links.effect: AI-only deferral missed 30.8% and 38.5% of malignancies; AI BI-RADS ≤3 plus non-suspicious MMG cut biopsies 43.5% with 100.0% sensitivity.
links.quote: Real-time AI breast US alone could not safely support biopsy deferral in US BI-RADS 4A lesions.

links.outcome: Missed cancers using AI-only versus AI gated by mammography findings
links.effect: Among lesions without suspicious MMG findings, no malignancies in AI BI-RADS 1-3 lesions; sequential strategy reduced biopsies 43.5% (279/641) with 100.0% sensitivity (95% CI, 87.1-100.0%).
links.quote: In contrast, among lesions without suspicious MMG findings, no malignancies were observed in AI BI-RADS 1-3 lesions.

links.quote: AI-only biopsy-deferral strategies missed 30.8% and 38.5% of malignancies when biopsy was deferred for AI BI-RADS ≤2 and ≤3 lesions, respectively, with DCIS accounting for most missed cancers.

links.outcome: biopsy reduction with AI plus mammography gating
links.effect: Sequential strategy reduced biopsies 43.5% (279/641), maintained 100.0% sensitivity (95% CI, 87.1-100.0%), and specificity was 45.4% (95% CI, 41.4-49.4%).
links.quote: The sequential strategy of deferring biopsy only for lesions with AI BI-RADS ≤3 and non-suspicious MMG findings reduced biopsies by 43.5% (279/641) while maintaining 100.0% sensitivity (95% CI, 87.1-100.0%) and increasing specificity to 45.4% (95% CI, 41.4-49.4%).
